features.quote: Hard caps: max turns, max wall-clock, max cost.
features.justification_quote: These are also your safety rails — a battery that can't terminate is its own incident.

features.quote: The useful version measures where an agent degrades so you can build guardrails
features.justification_quote: The less useful version just optimizes for "make the model spiral," which produces a number but no engineering signal.

features.quote: Keep tasks plausibly realistic; that's where the engineering value is.
features.justification_quote: If you ever tune the battery to maximize induction, you'll converge on adversarial nonsense prompts that tell you nothing about real-task robustness.
